title: Freightliner Cascadia Custom Built Hi-Tensile Aluminium FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar with Straight Pipes #19
description: Freightliner Cascadia FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Road Train Bullbar, Custom contoured heavy duty extra depth main channel with provision for Active Brake Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control. Heavy duty box uprights with combination daylight running indicator and park light LED lights in main channel. Flip-over Road Train signs on aluminium plate with polished reverse side. High tensile 6mm wall polished aluminium tube recessed welded into the box uprights, no but welds plus cutom made centre tube for LED Bar Light. Custom built light weight high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow 35mm tow pin. Cascadia branding embossed in end plates.
